subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an admin-only `sessions.files.set` text edit/save RPC for session workspace files, or should workspace writes stay out of this session surface for now?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and proven, but it creates a new host-file mutation surface in Gateway and current main recently established read-only workspace browsing boundaries, so automation should not decide that product/security boundary.

options.title: Rebase and accept admin-only writer
options.body: Require the branch to rebase onto current workspace-file helpers, then land if the owner accepts `operator.admin` session text writes as the intended boundary.

options.title: Narrow the writable subset
options.body: Ask for a smaller write surface, such as only previously previewed or transcript-touched text files, if arbitrary in-root text creation is broader than intended.

options.title: Defer to broader workspace CRUD
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want workspace editing handled only by a separate workspace management design instead of the session rail.

recommendation.title: Rebase and accept admin-only writer
recommendation.body: Require the branch to rebase onto current workspace-file helpers, then land if the owner accepts `operator.admin` session text writes as the intended boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on `agents.workspace`, `workspace-fs.ts`, and the workspace file viewer makes this the closest current owner for the security-boundary choice.
